theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → AEMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' x : ↥(R.carrier ∩ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) ⁻¹' {p}), (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier (x : Euclid P)).starProjection (inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) a • e - inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) e • a)‖) volume ∧ AEMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' x : ↥(R.carrier ∩ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) ⁻¹' {p}), (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞)) volume ∧ ∀ b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable b → (∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * ∑' x : ↥(R.carrier ∩ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) ⁻¹' {p}), (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier (x : Euclid P)).starProjection (inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) a • e - inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) e • a)‖ = ∫⁻ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, b (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) ∧ (∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * ∑' x : ↥(R.carrier ∩ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) ⁻¹' {p}), (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) = ∫⁻ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, b (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure)
